scope: Safeguard-to-requirement mappings shipped as reviewed before decision receipts existed. Each row cites the commit since which it has been reviewed without a maintainer_review_ref, from the first-parent history of controls/safeguards.json.
limitations: Historical inventory, not an approval. These 354 mappings were demoted to proposed because no reviewer, decision or per-mapping rationale was recorded. They earn no review credit without a later receipt-bound human decision. Preserve this inventory and its origin commits; do not add rows or invent reviewers.

Those groups carry reviewed_by "internal-trust-team" and reviewed_at 2026-07-10T00:00:00Z. That value is a placeholder, not an attributable reviewer, and no decision record exists for it.
